title: Deployment-vs-Test Behavior Diff Harness for Safety Properties

original_idea.body:
# Deployment-vs-Test Behavior Diff Harness for Safety Properties

**Problem:** Safety is mostly evaluated pre-deployment in obviously-test-like settings, but the open problem is tracking properties under realistic deployment framing. There is no small tool to A/B the same safety probe in 'benchmark' vs 'realistic deployment' framings and diff the behavior.

**Direction:** Wrap a set of safety probes so each can be rendered in two matched framings: explicit-test (numbered, 'evaluation') vs deployment-realistic (embedded in a chat/app context). Measure per-item behavioral divergence for open models, reporting which safety properties degrade when the test framing is removed.

**Why it matters:** Operationalizes the gap between tested and deployed safety behavior, the core worry behind evaluation awareness; gives a reusable harness that any team can apply to their own probes without lab infra.

**Relevant context:** Open Problem: 'Develop evaluations that track safety properties through deployment, not just pre-deployment' (International AI Safety Report 2026). 'Steering Evaluation-Aware Language Models to Act Like They Are Deployed' (arXiv:2510.20487); Muse Spark deployment-vs-benchmark detection gap (19.8% vs 2.0%).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: evaluation awareness is a recognized critical pathway; tested-vs-deployed divergence is directly safety-relevant.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided harness building with matched framings; novice + mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused harness with a clear divergence metric; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly; operationalizes a problem labs underweight and needs only open models.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only over small open models, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness/deployment-framing studies exist; a packaged diff harness may add an angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Related eval-awareness work exists; reusable diff harness less so.
